profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: My name is Bao and I'm a professional student. I love learning and solving problems all while enjoying the finer things in life, like rock climbing and cycling.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for backend distributed systems hosted in AWS and frontend insurance submission system.
SOC2 compliant system, hosted in AWS with Lambda, Step Function, DynamoDB, AuroraDB, Apprunner, AppSync, SQS, and Kinesis.
Built an in-house document storage system to remove storage errors with Box API, and provided foundation for AI enriched insurance quotes.
Built an email integration for companies to send emails within our app, using their company email inboxes. Allowed for advanced tracking of insurance submissions via Nylas integration.
Writeback data to broker EPIC databases for partner brokers.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Representational State Transfer (REST) · TypeScript · Scrum · Terraform · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Git · GraphQL · PostgreSQL · Web Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a technical team lead on our consumer facing pet health care app.
Backend development, supporting Android and iOS app users.
Traditional monolith with AWS RDS, Elasticsearch, Redis, ElasticSearch, and EC2 deployments.
Developed Fuzzy’s V2 API, improving response rates by over 20x. Established REST API standards for the company.
Co-Developed Fuzzy’s V2 authentication scheme to bring standard security practices to the company.
Led development of video chat services, allowing our veterinarians to prescribe medications over chat.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Representational State Transfer (REST) · TypeScript · Scrum · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Git · GraphQL · PostgreSQL · Web Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a full-stack engineer, I was responsible for our multi-tenant architecture, hosted on AWS, using EC2 and RDS, serving a SAAS app that processed hundreds of thousands of jobs per day.
React development, primarily centered around AG Grid to serve large datasets of option trades taken by our clients.
Built data pipelines to ingest daily market data from sources like CME to value option trades.
Developed architecture to handle scaling hundreds of thousands of jobs per day to value option trades for our clients.
Implemented Auth0 single-sign-on for our clients using Molecule web app.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Representational State Transfer (REST) · TypeScript · Scrum · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Git · PostgreSQL · Web Development

positions.title: Software Engineer / Scrum Master
positions.description:
As an engineer, I worked as a contractor for NOAA, to work on data pipelines that ingest large amounts of scientific data gathered by ocean going vessels. Earned trust of teammates, resulting in the dual role of engineer and scrum master soon after hire.
Backend developer and scrum master
Created an API to connect internal developers to a legacy data archive service,  which stored data onto magnetic tapes. The API provided the ability to put data into “cold” storage, as well as make it accessible on faster storage. The API allowed hundreds of TB of data to be moved in and out of cold storage.

Our main public facing project is located at https://data.noaa.gov/onestop/#/
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Scrum · JavaScript · Git · PostgreSQL · Web Development

positions.description: Standard gap year stuff. Backpacking, staying in hostels, learning, meeting new people.
